tokens.name: sage-500
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Large fields: page ground, hero panels, covers. Text on it is on-field (7.0:1); never white or off-white (2.2:1). Tomato never sits on it (1.7:1).

tokens.name: sage-100
tokens.usage: Lightest sage tint. Source of surface-tint in the light theme.

tokens.name: sage-200
tokens.usage: Light sage. Fill of a healthy or live Tag, with pine-900 text (12:1).

tokens.name: sage-300
tokens.usage: Strings in code on deep-raised (10:1). Sage text in the dark theme.

tokens.name: sage-700
tokens.usage: Text-safe sage on light grounds (5.5:1 on off-white). Fill of the main action on product screens, with white text (6.0:1). Lily pads in illustrations.

tokens.name: pine-900
tokens.usage: The ink. Text, line illustration and the dark chapter.

tokens.name: pine-800
tokens.usage: Raised step on pine in the dark theme.

tokens.name: pine-700
tokens.usage: Hairlines on pine. Hover of an ink Button.

tokens.name: tomato-500
tokens.usage: The brand accent at full value. Marks only: the bloom, the Underline, the wordmark dot, type of 24px and up on off-white (3.7:1). Never behind small text, never on sage.

tokens.name: tomato-600
tokens.usage: Tomato deepened so white text reads on it (4.8:1). Source of accent in the light theme.

tokens.name: tomato-700
tokens.usage: Hover of the accent Button. Tomato link text on light grounds (6.0:1).

tokens.name: tomato-100
tokens.usage: Tomato tint. Source of accent-tint in the light theme.

tokens.name: off-white
tokens.usage: The reading ground. Source of surface in the light theme. Chips in illustrations. The disc behind the bloom, and the Underline on field.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Raised cards in the light theme. Text on accent.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Ground of marketing pages and covers. Sheets sit on it. Its main action is the ink Button; tomato never sits on it.

tokens.name: on-field
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on field (7.0:1 light, 10:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-field-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on field (5.1:1 light, 6.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sheets: the ground for reading, product screens and forms.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on surface-tint. Selected Tab in a panel.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: A quiet panel inside a sheet that groups related cards.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint (15:1). Rules above columns. Fill of the ink Button, the main action on field (7.0:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface (7.1:1), surface-raised and surface-tint (6.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Sage-coloured text on surface: a healthy status word, the second voice in a statement (5.5:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between rows on surface. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls and outline Buttons (3.5:1 on surface, 3.3:1 on surface-tint).

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: The dark chapter: developer content and code. One per page.

tokens.name: deep-raised
tokens.usage: CodeBlock ground inside a deep sheet.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on deep and deep-raised (14:1).

tokens.name: on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on deep (8.0:1) and deep-raised (8.8:1).

tokens.name: deep-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and CodeBlock border on deep.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fill of the one main action on surface and deep, never on field (2.0:1). Text on it is on-accent (4.8:1 light, 5.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the accent Button.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Tomato text links on surface (6.0:1 light, 7.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-mark
tokens.usage: The bloom, the Underline on surface and deep, and the wordmark dot. Marks and 24px+ type only. Not on field, except the wordmark dot.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Row that waits for a person, with ink text (14:1).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Dot and word of a healthy status on surface (7.0:1). Always with a word.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of a healthy Tag: a light tint, so it differs in lightness from danger-fill (5:1).

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warning text on surface (6.5:1). Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text on surface (6.4:1). Errors are never tomato-500.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Solid fill of a failed Tag, with on-danger text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-fill (7.0:1 light, 8.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments in a CodeBlock on deep-raised (6.6:1).

tokens.name: code-key
tokens.usage: Keys in a CodeBlock on deep-raised (9.1:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 3px offset, on field and surface (7:1 and 15:1). On deep, use on-deep.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: AI agents for supply chain operations.
styles.usage: The one headline of a page. Scales down to 42px on a phone.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Automate the manual work in your supply chain.
styles.usage: Section titles, one per sheet. 34px on a phone.

styles.name: display-md
styles.sample: Purchase orders. Supplier follow-ups. Stock checks.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Card and column titles. 20px on a phone.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: LotusPond Works connects your ERP, warehouse, carrier and supplier systems.
styles.usage: The paragraph beside a headline. 18px on a phone.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Agents handle the routine work. A payment or an order waits for someone to approve it.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Text inside product screens and rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, chips and small headings.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code only. Never for labels or tags.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and between tabs. Sheet inset on a phone.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and between rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Sheet inset from the page edge and the gap between sheets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding. Button side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding. Gap between a headline and its lede.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a sheet.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Sheet top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows, inputs and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and CodeBlocks inside a sheet. Sheets on a phone.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, tabs and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A card on surface-tint. Nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The one floating card over an illustration.
